blocks.text: These are the areas in which your daily performance is reviewed. Your manager discusses them with you; they are a basis for feedback and support, and are never applied automatically.

items: A human manager reviews every KPI result with you; no decision about pay or discipline is ever made automatically from a KPI result.
Days of approved leave, sickness, training or system outage are excluded.
Targets are adjusted for part-time hours and during ramp-up for new starters.
You can see your own KPI data at any time and ask for corrections.
Any reasonable adjustment agreed with you also applies to these KPIs.

blocks.statement: Signing confirms that these KPIs have been discussed and agreed.
